## Design

### 2026-10-07 – October 6,

**3h**

October 6,
Today I started working on the Starbie project by reading the how to make your own Starbie guide. I first downloaded the care package then I unzipped the file.

October 7,
Today, I installed KiCad and I watched youtube videos explaining how to install the symbol and footprint libraries.
Next, i started the project and added all the symbols and connected them as instructed in the guide.

### 2026-10-08 – October 8,

**4h**

October 8,

Today, I started by updating the PCB from my schematic. I created a custom boundry on the edge cuts layer using a guide on kicad website and arranged my components inside of it. Then I routed the PCB. Next, I used the DRC (or Design Rules Check) to check the PCB for design mistakes. Then I got tons of warnings and it took me like 2 hours to fix the missing connections.
Lastly, I installed esp32 on my Arduino ide.
